positions.title: Senior Consultant, Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented features in Java to extend the functionality of SailPoint IdentityIQ for large government
agencies
• Independently architected and engineered custom onboarding and offboarding processes to
instantaneously process 2,000+ users in response to disaster recovery emergencies
• Coordinated with clients on the development, deployment, and troubleshooting of Identity and Access
Management (IAM) software to streamline joiner, leaver, and transfer processes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed Java based custom connector and processes to integrate SailPoint IdentityIQ with web services endpoints to ingest and transform JSON data provided by a RESTful API into user records
• Led development and implementation of 50,000+ user SailPoint IdentityIQ (on-prem and cloud hosted)
installation to secure federal government environments by providing agencies with a comprehensive view of user and device information

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a web page using JavaScript to display Earth satellite imagery livestreamed from AWS server
to Carr Astro
• Extended open-source University of Wisconsin software to support streaming of satellite data to web
clients
• Developed application to measure data throughput from remote AWS server to Carr Astro

positions.title: Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
• Served as liaison between customers, faculty and staff to resolve UMD network, directory, and telecommunication issues
• Facilitated the transition from Microsoft Exchange to Google Apps for Education for faculty and staff during the consolidation of all 13 different UMD email systems
• Aided students with navigation and functionalities of Linux servers
